title: Diwali Celebration – An Evening of Togetherness

summary: The Rotary Club of Chembur celebrated the auspicious occasion of Diwali with a special Diwali Puja at Aroma Organics Limited Office on 7th November 2026 at 10:00 AM.
description:
The Rotary Club of Chembur celebrated the auspicious occasion of Diwali with a special Diwali Puja at Aroma Organics Limited Office on 7th November 2026 at 10:00 AM.

All club members and their families were warmly invited to join the celebration and seek the blessings of Goddess Lakshmi for prosperity, happiness, peace and good health.

The celebration was filled with devotion, festive spirit and warmth. The puja was followed by lunch, providing a wonderful opportunity for members to come together, share joyful moments and strengthen their bonds of friendship and fellowship.

It was a lovely get-together that brought members closer and beautifully reflected the true spirit of Rotary – Togetherness, Friendship and Fellowship.
